notes: Two built-in descriptors are enabled (stardew AppID 413150 SMAPI detect-only file_drop; cyberpunk AppID 1091500 root_merge per-file install) and active_game names the ONE the panel acts on — switch_game rewrites it, no file hand-edit needed. rimworld is retained as a PLANNED descriptor purely so the 33 historical regression tests keep running (they pin DECKYMOD_GAME_ID=rimworld). factorio/valheim/future loaders are planned scaffolding refused by the capability gate. Round 77: a game with no descriptor here can be configured by the user at runtime (data/games/<appid>.json, engine root_merge, write only inside the user-declared folders); those records never appear in this file. There is NO universal one-click install. No path installs a loader, edits Steam launch options, writes a Proton pfx, or uses a DLL override; stardew stays read-only/detection when an external mod manager owns the Mods/ tree.

variables.DECKY_DATA: Decky-managed persistent data dir (DECKY_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_DIR/data). POSIX, on internal SSD.
variables.DECKY_INBOX: Fixed drop-folder for local ZIP files (DECKY_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_DIR/inbox).
variables.XDG_CONFIG: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME if set else $HOME/.config. Used for the game's state file.
variables.STEAM_LIBRARY: Resolved Steam library root that actually contains appmanifest_<appid>.acf for this game. NEVER hard-coded.
variables.APP_INSTALL_DIR: Verbatim 'installdir' value from appmanifest_<appid>.acf (case-sensitive, != store title).
variables.TXN_ID: Per-transaction opaque id (timestamp + random), used to namespace snapshots/quarantine.

allowed_write_roots_stardew_note: stardew uses the SAME Mods root but NO XDG state-file root (state_file=null, file_drop strategy). A sibling .decky-staging/.decky-quarantine on the Mods filesystem remains the single approved quarantine exception.
allowed_write_roots_note: Everything the plugin writes MUST be under one of these roots (or a sibling .decky-staging/.decky-quarantine of the SAME filesystem, see descriptor.paths). Quarantine is the one approved exception to '#4 journal/quarantine in DECKY_DATA': it must live on W2's filesystem to avoid EXDEV(18) on cross-device os.replace.

capability_gate.note: Any operation whose required capability is false returns E_CAPABILITY_DISABLED. A descriptor with status!=enabled returns E_CAPABILITY_DISABLED. There is no universal one-click install.

loader_catalog_note: smapi is DETECT-ONLY for stardew: it is checked for presence, NEVER installed (see loaders/smapi.json). Round 79: bepinex5/bepinex6_il2cpp/melonloader carry browse_url for the browser hand-off, and install_loader may extract a loader ZIP ONLY for descriptors whose capabilities.loader_install is true (user-configured games) — two-phase, journaled, backed up, rollback-able; launch options are NEVER edited. Built-in descriptors keep loader_install=false.

stardew.selection: B (approved 2026-11-14): Stardew Valley + SMAPI, DETECT-ONLY. Depends on a user-installed SMAPI + user-set Steam launch options; the plugin never installs a loader, never edits launch options, never writes pfx. Read-only mode when an external mod manager owns Mods/.

rimworld.selection: HISTORICAL REGRESSION (selection A, originally approved): retained so the 33 synthetic-tree tests keep running via DECKYMOD_GAME_ID=rimworld. No longer the active game since the user has no RimWorld installed. Not enabled in production.

factorio.selection: Demoted from the first draft's sample game. Kept as a second json_toggle_list shape example. NOT active in MVP.

valheim.selection: B (declined): BepInEx/Proton class. Would require loader install + WINEDLLOVERRIDES launch-option edit + pfx write, i.e. three §3.8 hard prohibitions. Refused.

cyberpunk.selection: Round 76 (user request): Cyberpunk 2077 file-drop support. root_merge engine writes ONLY inside archive/pc/mod, mods/, bin/x64/plugins, r6/scripts and red4ext, journals every file, and backs up any file it overwrites. Only ONE game is active at a time -- active_game decides which descriptor every RPC talks to.

registry_note: Two descriptors are enabled (stardew, cyberpunk) but active_game selects the single one the panel acts on. enabled_games() honours active_game first, so switching games never needs a descriptor edit.
